install.description: Builds a SwiftPM executable product in release and renames it over the copy SwiftPM's install folder holds, or installs it through experimental-install when the folder holds none

package.description: Zips each archived app and each SwiftPM executable product's release build with ditto; where ASC_API_KEY_P8, ASC_API_KEY_ID, and ASC_API_ISSUER_ID are set and a keychain holds a Developer ID Application identity, exports each archive under it into a disk image, signs it, notarizes it with that App Store Connect key, and staples the ticket

release-publish.description: Attaches each folder's disk image, else its zip, at the version nx release set to the project's GitHub release; where SPARKLE_ED_PRIVATE_KEY is set, adds each disk image holding a stapled notarization ticket to the Sparkle feed its app names in SUFeedURL

run.description: Runs swift and xcodebuild invocations in order with Nx's per-task environment removed, stopping at the first failure
